final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS grand_total FROM grouped), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, n, 1.0 * n / grand_total AS share FROM grouped CROSS JOIN total), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT shares.ordertypedist, shares.n, shares.share, shares.share - avg_share.mean_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE shares.share > avg_share.mean_share
